note: Gzip size, bytes, of the entry chunk index.html loads. ADR 0014's promise is that the three.js sail view does not land on first load; `bundle_check.mjs` is what makes that promise checkable. desktop-kite phase 02: the gennaker (ADR 0017). +3.0 KB over this branch's HEAD, which itself builds at 122380 B here — 663 B above the 121717 recorded on the cockpit branch, so re-measure HEAD before attributing a delta to your own change. Of the 3.0 KB, 1.3 KB is the plan view drawing the kite: `three/kite.ts` and `three/conventions.ts` become shared modules and move into the entry, because the 2D plan view is the always-loaded fallback and it now draws the sail too. Deliberate: ADR 0017 puts one kite mapping behind both pictures, and a second copy of it in plan-view coordinates would cost more in drift than it saves in bytes. No renderer code moved — checked, not assumed: the hull stations and the kite material are in the SailView3D chunk and not in the entry, and that chunk is still lazy at 140.1 KB gzip.

desktop-kite phase 05: the kite's flying shape from the measured research. Re-measured HEAD on this branch first, as the entry above says to: a clean HEAD build is 127114 B here, already +1730 over the recorded 125384, from phases landing in parallel. Of the +2666 B this phase adds on top of that, only 332 B is code: `luffLateral`, `clewOnCircle` and the AWA argument in `three/kite.ts`, which the plan view pulls into the entry because it draws the kite too. The other ~2.3 KB is prose. `More.svelte` imports `ASSUMPTIONS.md` as raw text, so the honesty surface is first-load bytes, and this phase moved most of the gennaker block off `assumed` onto its sources and had to say what each one is. That is the trade the project's honesty rule asks for, so it is taken deliberately rather than trimmed. No renderer code moved: the three.js hero chunk is still lazy at 139.0 KB gzip.
